sloka: आरुरोह नृपं द्रष्टुं सह सूतेन राघवः ।स प्राञ्^जलिरभिप्रेत्य प्रणतः पितुरन्तिके ॥२-३-३२॥
transliteration: āruroha nṛpaṁ draṣṭuṁ saha sūtena rāghavaḥ ।sa prāñ^jalirabhipretya praṇataḥ piturantike ॥2-3-32॥

translations.english: Rama, approached his father with folded palms and bowed low near him, pronounced his (own) name and touched his father's feet with reverence.
